title: Microsoft President Brad Smith: AI Systems Need an ‘Emergency Brake’
summary: Microsoft Vice Chair and President Brad Smith says some AI regulation is inevitable and argues that advanced AI systems should have an “emergency brake” that allows them to be slowed or shut down. In a conversation with WSJ Leadership Institute President Alan Murray, Smith explains why AI developers, cloud providers and companies deploying AI agents should all have the ability to stop systems that behave in unexpected or unsafe ways.

title: Microsoft President Brad Smith: AI’s Power Is Advancing Faster Than Its Safety
summary: Microsoft Vice Chair and President Brad Smith says AI has enormous potential to improve healthcare, productivity and other areas of society, but warns that its growing power requires stronger safeguards. In a conversation with WSJ Leadership Institute President Alan Murray, Smith discusses why advanced AI systems need an “emergency brake,” the responsibility of companies to govern the technology they build, and how businesses can harness AI while managing its risks.
